title: Chile Cuts Copper Production Forecast Again as Mine Woes Persist

title: 'Guac Signal' Sparked Chipotle's Frantic Bid to Recall Jalapeños
summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc. figured out that jalapeños were the source of a salmonella outbreak and began an automated recall system to notify restaurants and destroy the tainted peppers. Bloomberg's Daniela Sirtori joined Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
